title: DepictSpec
description:
Declarative document (`mol`, `group`, `reaction_scheme`, or `grid` root).

A root mol **is** [`MolNode`] — the same type as scheme / group children, so annotations (`region`, `circle`, `callout`, `atom_label`, `atom_number`, `name`, `shade`, …) are one schema everywhere.

oneOf.description: Mol node — [`MolOpts`] fields + non-cascading identity / scores / align.

atom_number.description: Atom index / map-number labels (`"index"` | `"mapno"` | policy object).

debug_align.description: Paint alignment correspondence (matched atom tags + mol role badge).

debug_box.description: Paint dashed debug rectangles for layout boxes (labels / mol / scene).

label.description:
Caption: [`Label`] (string id, list, or `{id, pos?}` — text-node refs).

Prefer privileged [`Self::name`] for inline mol captions. `label` id-refs remain for legacy / multi-caption layouts.

`pos` on a placement chooses caption side (`above`/`below`/`left`/`right`); hosts measure the resolved text and fold that into node size for layout.

name.description: Privileged figure name / caption painted inside the mol SVG (default below).

opts.description: Cascade patches for this node (list or singleton).

pad.description: Post-layout SVG viewBox pad (px). Omit → small house default (rarely override).

region.description: Region highlight(s) — one object or a list.

shade.description: Shade **scores** (+ legacy window); window also cascades via [`Opts`].

align.description: When true, later children align onto the first (or each `align_to`).

debug_align.description: Paint alignment correspondence (matched atom tags + mol role badge).

opts.description: Group-level cascade bag (list container for child inheritance).

pad.description: Post-layout SVG viewBox pad (px). Omit → small house default.

children.description: Child **nodes** — mols, edges, and text (any order).

debug_align.description: Paint alignment correspondence (matched atom tags + mol role badge).

layout.description: Scheme layout (direction, edge routing); backend maps these.

opts.description: Scheme-level cascade bag for child mol inheritance.

pad.description: Post-layout SVG viewBox pad (px). Omit → small house default.

oneOf.description: Grid root — each child is one row (`mol` / `group` / `reaction_scheme` / nested `grid`).

children.description: Row roots (nested grids flatten in document order when walking mols).

debug_align.description: Paint alignment correspondence (matched atom tags + mol role badge).

opts.description: Grid-level cascade bag (inherits onto every row / mol).

pad.description: Post-layout SVG viewBox pad (px). Omit → small house default.

oneOf.description: Branch-and-bound until timeout / node cap (house default).
Free CoordGen; ignore the parent template.

AlignTo.description: Document align target: id string or `{ "ref", "atom_map"?, "min_atoms"?, "mode"?, "timeout_ms"? }`.

AlignToSpec.description: Object form of document ``align_to`` (template ref + EdgePlan-style opts).

atom_map.description: Pairs `(query, template)` vs the template; skips MCS when set.

ref.description: Id of the template mol in this group.

timeout_ms.description: MCS budget in milliseconds. `None` = house 100 ms; `0` = unbounded.

AromaticStyle.description:
How fully aromatic rings are drawn.

``circle`` (default): skeleton singles + stroked ring circle for CTAB ``4`` / RDKit ``1.5`` rings. ``kekule``: alternating double/single strokes for paint only (stored bond orders on the molecule are unchanged).

AtomLabelDetailed.description: Expanded atom-label bag with optional shared scale/color/z.

AtomLabelSpec.description: Per-atom arbitrary text. Bare map `{ "0": "α" }` or `{ "labels": {…}, "scale"? }`.

AtomNumberBy.description: How to generate atom index / map-number labels.

only.description: Restrict to these atom indices (omit = all).

atoms.description: One circle centered on each atom index.

ring.description: Ordered ring atoms — one circle at the ring centroid (aromatic-style).

EdgeArrow.description: Arrow head / shaft style for diagram edges.

EdgeNode.description:
Edge **node** — a reaction / network link between mol ids.

[`Self::sources`] / [`Self::targets`] are one or many mol ids (A+B → C+D). Label chrome refs sibling text/mol nodes via [`Self::label`].

label.description:
Label chrome: id / list / `{id, pos?}` / `{above,below,left,right}`.

Hosts should measure each placement’s text (or mol viewport) and pass those boxes to the layout engine with the placement `pos` (edge side).

role.description: Optional semantic role (e.g. enzyme) — not drawn by default.

type.description: Wire discriminant — required so untagged [`Node`] does not absorb edges as mols.

EdgeRouting.description: How edge shafts are drawn between nodes.

ForTypesPatch.description:
Multi-kind patch: `{ "for_types": ["mol","group"], …mol opts }`.

Carries full [`MolOpts`] so mol-only keys (`weight` / `halo` / `shade`) can target mols via `for_types` without a separate typed mol patch.

Label.description:
Unified label: string id, list, placed object, or lane object.

```json "label": "adh" "label": ["adh", {"id": "rt", "pos": "below"}] "label": { "id": "adh", "pos": "left" } "label": { "above": ["adh"], "below": ["rt"], "left": ["nabh4"] } ```

anyOf.description: Explicit above / below / left / right id lists.

LabelItem.description: One entry in a label list: bare id or `{ id, pos? }`.

LabelPos.description: Side of an edge shaft (or mol caption) for a label placement.

LayoutAlgorithm.description:
Placement algorithm for scheme layout.

Hosts map these onto ELK (or another engine): - [`Self::Layered`] — Sugiyama / layered (default; best for reactions) - [`Self::Radial`] — hub-and-spoke / concentric rings (star-like nets) - [`Self::Force`] — force-directed (undirected / cyclic networks) - [`Self::Stress`] — stress majorization (compact network alternative)

LayoutOpts.description:
Layout for [`DepictSpec::ReactionScheme`].

Backend-agnostic knobs — hosts map these onto ELK, Dagre, or another engine. Defaults when omitted: [`LayoutDirection::Right`], [`EdgeRouting::Polyline`], [`LayoutAlgorithm::Layered`]. Individual [`EdgeNode`]s may override [`Self::edge_routing`].

Spacing (px, document space) controls packing tightness: - [`Self::node_spacing`] — gap between nodes in the same layer (default ~20) - [`Self::layer_spacing`] — gap between reactant/product layers (default ~0)

layer_spacing.description: Between-layer gap along the flow axis (px). Smaller → tighter pack.

node_spacing.description: Within-layer node gap (px). Smaller → tighter pack.

MolIds.description:
One or more mol ids (reactants / products).

Wire: `"a"` or `["a", "b"]` — reactions may have multiple reactants and products.

MolOpts.description:
Mol cascading paint opts — what a mol leaf consumes from the cascade.

[`MolNode`] carries the same fields at the top level (local leaf opts) plus non-cascading identity keys.

MolText.description: Caption / label content: bare string or styled object.

anyOf.description: Plain string (default placement depends on consumer: mol name → below).

MolTextSpec.description: Expanded text content for mol name, region labels, callouts, atom labels.

margin.description: Gap (px) between mol ink AABB and this caption (snug, no clash). Omit → house default (see caption paint `CAPTION_MARGIN_DEFAULT`).

place.description: Region label: inside the hull or outside (default outside).

pos.description: Side relative to the anchor (mol name / outside region label).

scale.description: Font scale relative to house atom-label size (mol `name` defaults to 1.5×).

Node.description:
Document **node**: mol, edge, or text.

Untagged so each variant keeps its own `"type"` field. - [`DepictSpec::Group`]: mol | text (no edges). - [`DepictSpec::ReactionScheme`]: mol | edge | text.

NodeType.description: Document node kinds opts may target (matches wire `"type"` discriminants).

oneOf.description: Multi-mol scheme with edge nodes in `children` (`"type": "reaction_scheme"`).

Opts.description: Cascade bag: singleton patch or list of patches.

OptsPatch.description: One cascade rule. Untagged order: typed → for_types → universal.

anyOf.description:
`{ "color": "#111", "weight": 1.2 }` — applies to every kind ([`MolOpts`]).

Universal is [`MolOpts`] (not [`CommonOpts`]) so container bags can stamp mol-only keys without wrapping `{ "type": "mol", … }`.

RegionSpec.description: One region highlight on a mol.

atoms.description: Atom indices that must lie inside the region.

exclude.description: Atom indices that must stay outside.

z.description: Optional z-order override (lower = further back). Default band: region base.

RegionTextPlace.description: Where a region caption sits relative to the region geometry.

ShadeSpec.description:
Per-atom / per-bond colormap scores (+ legacy window fields on the mol).

Prefer putting `colormap` / `vmin` / `vmax` in cascading [`MolOpts::shade`]; values here still apply as local leaf overrides for compat.

colormap.description: Named colormap. Only ``"xenosite"`` (default) is painted; any other name is rejected at depict time (not silently ignored).

ShadeStyle.description: Cascading shade window / LUT (not per-atom scores).

colormap.description: Named colormap. Only ``"xenosite"`` (default) is painted; any other name is rejected at depict time (not silently ignored).

StrokeSpec.description:
Stroke ink for region / circle.

Omit / `null` with a fill → no stroke. Omit / `null` without fill → house outline. Set `color: "none"` (or `width: 0`) to force no stroke; set a [`StrokeSpec`] object to force an outline even when filled.

color.description: CSS color, or `"none"` to disable stroke.

TextNode.description:
Text **node** — caption / chrome referenced by mols and edges via id.

```json { "type": "text", "id": "adh", "text": "ADH" } ```

id.description: Stable id — required when other nodes [`MolNode::label`] / edge lanes ref it.

[`MolNode`] carries the same fields at the top level (local leaf opts) plus non-cascading identity keys.
